headline: Raymond Realty auditor resigns over fee dispute
summary: Chaturvedi & Shah LLP resigned as joint statutory auditor of Raymond Realty Ltd citing unresolved audit fee revisions. Walker Chandiok continues as auditor.

headline: Vaibhav Global Q2FY27 results and dividend
summary: Vaibhav Global reported Q2FY27 consolidated net profit of ₹41.71 crore, down 12% YoY. Revenue rose 7% to ₹938 crore. Board declared ₹1.50 interim dividend.

headline: Stocks in News: Bandhan Bank, PNB Housing, Pidilite in focus
summary: Bandhan Bank rallies 2.3% on stellar Q2 profit surge, while Pidilite slips 4.2% as margins contract. PNB Housing jumps 3.9% on record disbursements.
